title: Phylex
notes:
BGP sessions are available over GRE, WireGuard, or direct interconnection where available.

IPv4 and IPv6 are supported. Customers may receive a full table, partial table, or default route depending on their requirements.

Automatic prefix filters can be generated from an ASN or AS-SET using IRR and RPKI data. Downstream ASN support and BGP community passthrough are available.

Small-scale sessions start at €5/month with a €5 one-time tunnel setup fee. Larger or advanced configurations start from €20/month.

Settlement-free peering or free upstream connectivity may be available on a case-by-case basis.

All announced prefixes must be properly authorized through valid ROAs, IRR route objects, an LOA, or another acceptable form of authorization.

Phylex may reject unauthorized, RPKI-invalid, incorrectly registered, abusive, or technically unsafe announcements.

Custom routing policies, redundant sessions, multiple tunnels, private interconnections, and non-standard configurations can be discussed individually.

Availability, final pricing, and technical requirements depend on the location, number of prefixes, expected traffic, routing policy, and connection type.
